'''Ticket Master''' is an [[NPC]] located in various [[Locations]] around the [[Dwarven Mines]] that allows players to easily travel around the [[Dwarven Mines]] at a cost. The cost of the minecart ride is calculated by multiplying the distance to the destination by {{Gold|2x}}.
